name: Pako ☆ Sis ~Bitch na Imouto to Hame Pako Dousei Seikatsu~
original_name: ぱこ☆シス　～ビッチな妹とハメぱこ同棲性活～
source:
"I'll give you some service as thanks for letting me crash at your place ♪"
Living under the same roof with a slutty demon of a little sister!

The protagonist of this game is an office worker who left home and started living alone in his apartment. One day, his sister who had gotten into a quarrel with their father and ran away from home, appears on his doorstep uninvited. It had been a while since they last met and so the protagonist is really surprised at her appearance: she has turned into a promiscuous blond-haired kogal!

Getting irritated by his hopelessly selfish little sister, the protagonist is about to throw her out of the house, but her skilled sexy seductions coax him into following up on her request and allows her to stay.

This marks the the beginning of their perverted life in cohabitation.

[Translated from the [url=http://pacopacosoft.jp/plus/product/pac002/index.html]Official website[/url]]
translation:
“我会为你提供一些服务，作为感谢让我在你这里过夜♪”
与放荡恶魔妹妹同住一个屋檐下！

游戏的主角是一名上班族，他离家出走，开始独自住在自己的公寓里。有一天，因与父亲争吵而离家出走的妹妹不请自来地出现在他家门口。距离上次见面已经有一段时间了，主角对她的出现感到非常惊讶：她变成了一个淫荡的金发科伽尔！

主角被他那无可救药的自私妹妹激怒了，正要把她赶出家门，但她熟练的性感诱惑诱使他答应了她的要求，并让她留下来。

这标志着他们变态的同居生活的开始。
